paragraphs: Accusoft is a high-performance, modern full-stack enterprise web application designed for financial ledger tracking, expense categorization, interactive analytical reporting, document management, and client-side zero-knowledge encrypted credential security.
✨ Key Features • 🌐 Live Deployment • 🛠️ Tech Stack • 📁 Project Structure
features: Smart Tracking: Real-time logging of operational and organizational expenses with category tags and dynamic filters.
Voucher Workflows: Multi-stage office expense vouchers with automatic calculations, date ranges, and approval flows.
Dynamic Breakdown: Filter by categories, date intervals, and custom attributes.
Visual Analytics: Interactive data visualization powered by Chart.js and React-Chartjs-2.
Ledger Records: Credit/Debit auditing with detailed breakdown, transaction logs, and statistical trends.
